notes: τὴν ἐνάτην has a Greek article, so rules 49 and 102 rightly give it both the determiner and the supplied 'hour' and leave the ordinal bare — the deliberate contrast with 10:3 and 10:9, where the phrase is anarthrous and rule 58 applies.
προσευχόμενος carries the discontinuous 'keeping … of prayer' headed on 'prayer' under rule 91, and ταύτης empties its article under rule 38.
